name: Allura Red AC
aliases: E129, INS 129, allura red AC, allura red, FD&C Red No. 40, FD&C Red 40, Red 40
what_is: A synthetic food colour identified in the EU as E129.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E129 because EU Regulation 1333/2008 places it among the colours for which specified foods must carry the additional statement that the colour may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children, subject to the regulation's exceptions. This is a labelling requirement, not a prediction of an effect in a particular child.
can_1: Detect E129 and the principal declared names for Allura Red AC.
can_2: Show the EU additional-labelling context without converting the warning rule into an individual medical conclusion.
cannot_1: Determine the amount of colour present from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Predict whether a particular child will experience an effect or assume that the same warning wording applies in every jurisdiction.
